citations.claim: First pole_upright violation at step 34: theta -0.853 rad exceeds 0.8 limit, system energy has grown to ~32.16
Cart position at failure step shows large excursion driven by instability
Four steps before failure pole was near upright (theta -0.03) but cart velocity already 5.5 m/s diverging

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.01455 to 0, keeping dt, steps, plant, initial and seed identical; noisy angle measurement was destabilizing the feedback at large dt 0.0194

explanation: With dt~0.0194 (near max) and sensor_noise~0.0145, seeded noisy theta measurement corrupts state-feedback. Trace shows oscillation growing: theta 0.14 at step10, 0.47 at step20, then rapid fall to -0.62 at step33 and -0.85 at step34 with omega -12.3 rad/s and v 7.5 m/s, controller force ~22-37N chasing noise. Removing noise alone stabilizes the run, proving noise-induced loss of stabilizing phase margin at coarse sampling is the cause.
vision_note: The cart drifts rightward while the pole leans progressively farther to the side from near-upright in steps 31-32. By step 34 the pole is tipped over at a large angle and highlighted in red as the violating body.
